rubrics.justification: The response materially contradicts the provided laboratory grading of 3AA by downgrading the embryo to 4BB/4BC and describing a loose ICM and irregular TE despite the case data specifying tightly packed ICM and cohesive TE.

It integrates most relevant factors well, including age, BMI, ovarian response, male factor diagnosis, sperm parameters, endometrium, and first-cycle status, though some links to embryo quality are speculative.
The structure is logical, but the prognosis and probability estimate are built on an incorrect morphological assessment, and several effect-size adjustments are asserted without strong support.

Some recommendations are standard (SET, luteal support), but others are weakly supported or not guideline-based for this case, including routine consideration of PGT-A at age 30, ERA/immunologic workup after failures, adding estradiol, and DHEA/CoQ10 suggestions.
The response gives clear next steps for transfer and contingency planning, but some recommendations are not appropriately evidence-based or tailored enough to be ideal.
